name: blurred
description: Your photos the blur filter hides (shown blurred everywhere, never loaded): show them all or blur them again (the timeline's Show blurred / Blur again), show one (the viewer's Show), refresh. Always shown after sign-in.

actions.name: blur_again
actions.description: Blur them all again (forgets the one-by-one Show too), as Blur again does. Only while shown

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Ask the server for the list again, as coming back to the app does (without its throttle)

actions.name: show
actions.description: Show one blurred photo, as the viewer's Show does

actions.name: show_all
actions.description: Show every blurred photo until the app restarts, as the timeline's Show blurred does. Only when some are blurred

loaded.description: The server's list has arrived (before: every photo blurred if the filter was active last time)

ids.description: Node ids the blur filter blurs

revealAll.description: Show blurred is on: every photo shows, until the app restarts

revealed.description: Photos shown one by one (the viewer's Show), until the app restarts
